name: AMS 1
author: AMS
description: The AMS flagship and the default theme: a sticky header, one centred hero, a featured card, post and tool grids and a four-column footer, with a layout for every page — home, blog list, post, page, tools index, a tool page, services, contact and 404 — and labelled, well-spaced ad slots on posts and tool pages only.

settings.label: Hero heading
settings.help: Leave empty to use the site title.

settings.label: Hero paragraph
settings.help: Leave empty to use the tagline from Settings.

settings.label: Call-to-action heading
settings.default: Need a website or app built?

settings.label: Call-to-action text
settings.default: Flask apps, websites, Android apps and business software.

settings.label: Show the reading-time estimate on posts
Show the key-takeaway box on posts
Key takeaway (default)
settings.help: Shown in the highlighted box on every post. Per-post wording belongs in the post itself.

settings.label: Blog list introduction
settings.default: Guides on AI, Android, Python and web development.

settings.label: Tools index introduction
settings.default: Simple tools that run in your browser. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

settings.label: Services introduction
settings.default: I build software for small and mid-size businesses.

settings.label: Post ad slot 1 — after the article
settings.help: Paste your ad code (AdSense or any other network). Empty means no slot is printed at all. Follow the network's policy: ads on posts and tool pages only, never next to a button, never on a page with little text.

settings.label: Post ad slot 2 — end of the post
settings.help: A second slot after the comments. Only worth using on posts of 1000+ words.

settings.label: Tool page ad slot — below the tool
settings.help: One slot, kept below the tool and away from the button.

settings.label: Contact form endpoint
settings.help: A form service URL (Formspree, your own handler). Leave empty to show the details column only, with no form.

changelog.notes: First release: the full AMS page set as theme layouts, with labelled ad slots on posts and tool pages only.

widgets.label: Footer
widgets.help: Three columns under the theme footer.

widgets.label: After a post
widgets.help: Shown after the post content, above the footer.
